brief:
Jericho and Jordan Valley Governor received the papal nuncio to Jerusalem and Palestine, the Ma'an news agency reported. The meeting provided an opportunity to review the current situation in the governorate and discuss matters of mutual concern.

Details of the discussions and specific topics addressed were not immediately disclosed. The papal nuncio represents the Vatican's diplomatic presence in the Palestinian territories.
title: Jericho governor meets papal nuncio to discuss provincial conditions
